user_story: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking that does not exist to return a not-found error so that I know the ID is invalid.

positive.title: Retrieve a booking with a valid ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve booking with a valid booking ID that exists in the system.
Check the response from the server.
positive.expected_result: The system returns the booking details associated with the valid booking ID.

negative.title: Retrieve a booking with an invalid ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve booking with an invalid booking ID.
Check the response from the server.
negative.expected_result: The system returns a 404 Not Found error with a message indicating the booking ID is invalid.

edge.title: Retrieve a booking with a non-existent ID format
steps: Send a request using an ID format that is not used (e.g. an alphanumeric string, special characters).
Check the response from the server.
edge.expected_result: The system returns a 404 Not Found error with a message indicating the booking ID is invalid.
